guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Chad Taylor was Live's guitarist, generally associated with Gibson-style solid-bodies typical of 90s alt-rock.

tone.target: chorused clean-to-edge breakup with delay wash
tone.profile: chorused clean-to-edge breakup with delay wash
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing compression and Chorus for arpeggios, followed by a clean British amp model (UK 50) for light breakup, finished with a lush Digital Delay and Room reverb to create the desired dark, washed texture.
